slopmatica.menu.title: Slopmatica
slopmatica.menu.keybinds_hint: Keybinds: Options > Key Binds... (or Controls > Key Binds)
slopmatica.browser.title: Load Schematic
slopmatica.placements.title: Loaded Placements
slopmatica.materials.title: Material List: %s
slopmatica.options.title: Slopmatica Options
slopmatica.options.show_ghosts.tooltip: Draw the missing blocks as see-through ghosts. Outlines are controlled separately.
slopmatica.options.ghost_opacity.tooltip: How solid ghost blocks look. Lower is more see-through.
slopmatica.options.show_outlines.tooltip: Turns every outline on or off at once (there is a hotkey for this in Key Binds). The per-colour switches below are kept as they are.
slopmatica.options.outline_missing.toolt: Outline blocks that have not been placed yet.
slopmatica.options.outline_match.tooltip: Outline blocks that exactly match the schematic.
slopmatica.options.outline_variant.toolt: Outline blocks of the right kind in the wrong state: facing, half, waxed vs unwaxed copper, oxidation and so on.
slopmatica.options.outline_wrong.tooltip: Outline blocks that are a different block entirely.
slopmatica.options.outline_width.tooltip: 100% is half as thick as vanilla's block outline, seen from 6 blocks away. Outlines have a fixed thickness in the world, so they get thinner with distance just like the blocks do.
slopmatica.options.fade_outlines.tooltip: Fade blue and green outlines with distance so large builds stay readable. Yellow and red never fade.
slopmatica.options.fade_start.tooltip: Blue and green outlines are fully visible up to this distance.
slopmatica.options.fade_end.tooltip: Blue and green outlines are gone beyond this distance.
slopmatica.keys.title: Slopmatica Key Binds
slopmatica.options.paste_replace.none.to: Pasting only fills empty space; blocks already in the world stay.
slopmatica.options.paste_replace.with_no: The schematic's blocks overwrite what is in the way. Its air leaves things alone.
slopmatica.options.paste_replace.all.too: An exact copy: the schematic's air clears whatever is there too.
slopmatica.menu.copy.tooltip: Copy the selection (set its corners with the Set Selection Corner key) to schematics/copies/
slopmatica.menu.paste.tooltip: Load the last copy under your crosshair and position it in the placement view
slopmatica.view.title: Placement View
slopmatica.view.paste.tooltip: Build this placement into the world (creative only). What it may overwrite is set in Options.
slopmatica.view.reset.tooltip: Put it back where it was when the placement view opened
slopmatica.view.forward: Nudge away from the camera (Shift: 5 blocks)
slopmatica.view.up.label: Up
slopmatica.view.down.label: Down
slopmatica.view.rotate_ccw.label: Rotate L
slopmatica.view.rotate_cw.label: Rotate R
slopmatica.view.mirror.label: Mirror
slopmatica.browser.upload.tooltip: Copy this schematic into schematics/cloud/ and upload it. It then appears in every game logged in with your Minecraft account.
slopmatica.cloud.title: Slopmatica Cloud
slopmatica.cloud.hint: Cloud schematics are kept in schematics/cloud/
slopmatica.options.exit_view_when_hurt.t: In survival and adventure, taking damage closes the placement view so you can deal with whatever is hurting you. Creative is never affected.
slopmatica.options.view_collision.toolti: The placement view's camera bumps into blocks like you do. Turn off to fly through walls (noclip). Ghost blocks never block it.
slopmatica.options.copy_format.slopmatic: Slopmatica's own format: small files, fast to load. Recommended.
slopmatica.options.copy_format.nbt.toolt: Vanilla structure files, for structure blocks and /place template. Much bigger files for large builds.
slopmatica.options.copy_format.litematic: Litematica's format, for sharing with Litematica users.
slopmatica.options.block_info.tooltip: Top right: the schematic block under your crosshair, its status, and for yellow and red blocks exactly what differs (placed → wanted).
slopmatica.options.include_nbt.tooltip: Copy and paste block data (chest contents, sign text, banner patterns) and entities (item frames, armor stands, paintings, mobs). Off: blocks only.
slopmatica.options.easy_place_on.tooltip: Right-click a missing ghost block to place exactly that block, facing the right way. The item is taken from your hotbar or inventory (in creative, made for you). Hold right click to keep placing. Has a toggle key in Key Binds.
slopmatica.options.easy_place_restrict.t: While Easy Place is on, placing a block where the schematic wants a different block (or air) is refused. Using doors, levers, chests and the like still works.
slopmatica.easy_place.no_support: Easy Place: nothing next to the %s to place it against (Angel Placement in Options allows mid-air)
slopmatica.easy_place.refused: Easy Place: the schematic wants %s here
slopmatica.easy_place.refused_air: Easy Place: the schematic wants this spot empty
slopmatica.options.easy_place_rotate.too: Easy Place briefly turns you to the facing a block needs, for that one click (angle placement, as Litematica does; most servers allow it). Off: you are never turned; blocks that need a facing are only placed when you look that way, and you are told which way.
slopmatica.easy_place.face: Easy Place: face %s to place this
slopmatica.options.easy_place_angel.tool: Easy Place can place blocks floating in mid-air, with nothing next to them, as Litematica does. Vanilla servers accept it; some anti-cheat plugins don't. Placing against a neighbour is still preferred when that gives the right block.
slopmatica.cloud.password.tooltip: Opens your account page on the website, already logged in. Set a password there to log in on the website directly with your Minecraft name, without the game.
